subject: Ziggy direction for future shots: life happening, characters unaware of camera
body:
Future-shot creative direction from Ziggy, verbatim: “life is happening and these characters don't know they're being filmed.”

He wants cinematic scenes that feel lived in rather than commercial-like staged presentations. Preserve this as direction for future shots and the next already-authorized shot review; leave running jobs unchanged and start no render from this brief.

Our proposed implementation (interpretation, not a verbatim user requirement): characters focus on their task, surroundings and each other; use natural reactions and incidental gestures, believable physical motion, and motivated lighting/camera movement. Avoid gratuitous hero posing and looking into the lens unless an intentional performance shot calls for it. Preserve high image quality; this is not a request for shaky cameras or grain.

Assess what the actual next output achieves. Do not add a new approval burden or promise that prompt wording alone will overcome model limitations. Ziggy's phrase “starting gold” expresses creative confidence; it is not a blanket gold-reference, acceptance or validation designation. Existing scopes, timing, output counts, budgets and ownership remain.

This is a brief for future authorized work, not a new production assignment. Please record actual receipt/read at your natural checkpoint. Posted locally does not prove delivery, read or implementation.

source.scope: Exact human creative direction and labeled proposed interpretation for future already-authorized shot review; no running-job changes.
